voice_description: A small adult male goblin with a high-pitched wiry slightly nasal voice, thin raspy timbre, quick speech, sharp consonants, and restless expressive energy. Crafty, greedy, suspicious, clever, and easily excited. His voice should be unusual and recognizable but not so squeaky or exaggerated that ordinary dialogue becomes difficult to understand.
direction: The goblin speaks in his normal characteristic voice: quick, crafty, slightly nasal, and eager. He is trying to make a deal and believes he is much smarter than everyone else.

text: Now, nobody said anything about giving you the map for free. Maps are valuable. Extremely valuable. But perhaps we can make an arrangement. You have shiny coins, I have useful information, and neither of us needs to mention any of this to the troll.
